data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hayy', meaning 'alive' or 'living'. In Islamic tradition, the name Heyam symbolizes the essence of life and the importance of cherishing every moment. The name Heyam carries the meaning “Life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Heyam usually hope their child will grow to embody life and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heyam total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
